title: Microsoft 365 license usage
pitch: Put assigned against purchased for every SKU and price the seats nobody uses.
makeItYours: Replace the inline SKUs with your tenant's subscribed SKUs and their consumed units.
Set each SKU's price from your agreement and change the 90% and 70% thresholds.
Add an owner per SKU so the reclaim list names who to ask.
useCase: Use it when a renewal is coming and you need to know which licenses are paid for but not assigned.
